title: Fifth National Climate Assessment Midwest chapter
product_or_endpoint: Regional climate hazards, infrastructure, agriculture, and ecological context
use_limitations: Regional assessment; not a local damage, outage, or health model.

title: Fifth National Climate Assessment energy chapter
product_or_endpoint: Heat, cooling demand, and energy-system context
use_limitations: Supports direction and mechanism; no local outage probability.

title: EPA Great Lakes climate indicators
product_or_endpoint: Observed lake levels/temperature and variability context
use_limitations: Observed indicators and synthesis; not a shoreline or damage model.

title: NOAA seiche explanation
use_limitations: Mechanism source; no local recurrence estimate.

title: NOAA GLERL Great Lakes ice cover
use_limitations: Lake-wide ice cover does not establish local shoreline ice shove or harbor conditions.

title: NOAA Office for Coastal Management Lake Level Viewer
use_limitations: Calm-day mapped extent excludes wind-driven waves and seiche; not a local damage model.

title: NOAA CO-OPS inundation database
use_limitations: Registry-only context; not adopted as a new inundation footprint or claim-row source in this qualitative layer.

title: NWS Great Lakes observations
product_or_endpoint: Lake wind, wave, and observation service context
use_limitations: Observation access does not imply complete shoreline coverage.

title: NWS Cleveland winter forecasts
product_or_endpoint: Snow, ice, and winter forecast products
use_limitations: Forecast products are not historical climatology or infrastructure-loss estimates.

title: Western Lake Erie agricultural and meteorological HAB study
use_limitations: Mechanism evidence; no future bloom magnitude or health outcome.

title: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer
use_limitations: Registry-only parallel source; Phase 9A b9_fema_nfhl is the claim-row source. Regulatory zones remain distinct from observed flood footprints.

title: Ohio EPA NPDES program
product_or_endpoint: Permitted discharge and treatment regulatory context
use_limitations: Permits are not actual loads or evidence of local control performance.

title: USFWS National Wetlands Inventory
product_or_endpoint: Wetland inventory and broad retention/transformation interface
use_limitations: Inventory presence does not establish condition or a uniform removal rate.

title: Ohio H2Ohio program
product_or_endpoint: Nutrient-management, wetlands, and water-quality intervention context
use_limitations: Program context does not establish farm-level adoption or achieved reduction.
